content: In-memory caching in a Next.js serverless function is per-warm-instance only and not guaranteed to persist; acceptable for a short-lived demo process, but the alternative (HTTP Cache-Control s-maxage/stale-while-revalidate at the edge) is the more robust option if deployed to Vercel; for a local/single-process demo, a simple in-memory Map with TTL is sufficient and simplest.
